how it works ▾
How to play
1 · Look at the eye photo above.
2 · From the menu, pick what you think it is — a healthy eye, or one of the diseases.
3 · The AEGIS Unified Engine reads the same photo and reveals the answer in plain language — see if you beat it.
4 · Watch for the traps: some eyes look perfectly normal but are actually diseased. Those are the ones a quick glance misses — exactly what the engine is built to catch.
Tap Next case to continue. A learning game and screening aid — never a diagnosis; a clinician always stays in charge.
Under the hood — the AI/ML engine we built ▾
The Unified Engine — one AI/ML core, every disease.
1
It reads the retina — a deep neural network turns each photo into a numeric fingerprint (same recipe for every disease).
2
A panel of specialists checks it — one trained model per disease, each tested honestly (duplicate photos removed so scores can't cheat).
3
One answer, one route — the verdicts combine into a single result pointing to the right specialist.
One pass, read by every specialist at once — then routed to the right expert. A clinician stays in command.
A purpose-built system — designed, trained and validated in-house by AEGIS (Dr Loh Kah Meng).

Want AEGIS to look at your eye image?

This demo runs on a fixed set of example fundus photos. If you would like to share your own retinal fundus image for an illustrative, educational read — not a diagnosis — you can send it to the programme through the Contact channel. Please read the terms below first; sending an image means you accept them.

Please read — terms of any image you submit.
1. Not a medical device and not a diagnosis. AEGIS is a research and educational demonstration. Nothing it outputs is medical advice, a diagnosis, a screening result, or a substitute for a qualified clinician. No doctor–patient relationship is created.
2. Do not send identifiable patient data. Remove all names, IDs, dates of birth, and any protected health information (PHI) before sending. Only submit an image you have the right to share. Do not send anyone else’s medical data without their consent.
3. You release AEGIS from liability. By submitting, you agree to indemnify and hold harmless AEGIS, Dr Loh Kah Meng, and anyone associated with the programme from any and all claims, losses, or liability arising from your use of, or reliance on, anything AEGIS provides. You use it entirely at your own risk.
4. Always consult a licensed clinician. For any real eye or health concern, see a qualified doctor or ophthalmologist. Do not delay or disregard professional medical advice because of anything here.
